relation_to_reviewed_code: Separate runner. It imports pure helpers (name rules, endpoint derivation, weights, probability checks, metrics, calibration) from the reviewed synthetic-only analysis/paired_projection_reference.py without editing or bypassing it.
question: On real neurons from separate animals, does measured endogenous gene expression plus measured position predict an observed captured projection label better than location-only and copying controls?
real_run_requirements_checked_before_any: real runs only through execute(): fixed run_id; run directory created exclusively; duplicate run_id refused

admission record (path + SHA-256) with status ADMITTED for this dataset_id, binding: the four data-file hashes, analysis_config_sha256 (canonical: dataset_id, run_class, fold_scheme, endpoint_mode, targets in order, group_unit, groups with animal mappings, per_cell_join, genes, position columns/dims/source, technical columns, label semantics, frozen cohort, file hashes), runner_sha256 (executing file), reference_sha256 (imported analysis/paired_projection_reference.py), protocol_sha256
this protocol committed in git, unmodified, and with status FROZEN_EXPLORATORY_AUTHORIZED; the DRAFT status refuses every real run
run_class must be 'exploratory' for real runs; the confirmatory path is disabled; exploratory runs carry no power approval and never PASS

all reviewed checks: explicit endpoint mode; true animal/pool identities (non-blank, unpadded, disjoint); slice/section/hemisphere refused as groups; independence evidence; exact cell-ID joins; explicit complete target-by-group mask; forbidden reporter/vector/target/class names in every predictor role; disjoint unique schema names; canonical cell_id order; probabilities exact-shape, finite, in [0, 1]

position.dims: 1 to 3 measured axes, declared explicitly as position_columns and position_dims
position.provenance: position_source must be 'measured_in_same_cell'; inferred, imputed, mapped or Tangram-type coordinates are refused (also refused by provenance keywords)

technical_control: Only when authentic technical variables exist (technical_evidence required). With no technical columns the technical control is recorded as not available; no dummy covariates are invented.
frozen_cohort: Before any fitting, the manifest pins per endpoint the SHA-256 and count of the sorted eligible cell IDs (assayed, QC-passed, endpoint-eligible). A mismatch refuses the run before the gene matrix is read.

candidate.model: sklearn 1.8 LogisticRegression, L2 (default), C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter 2000, tol 1e-6, random_state 20261112
candidate.features: log1p measured endogenous markers + measured position
candidate.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training animals only

controls.location_logistic: same logistic settings and weights on fit-scaled measured position only
controls.molecular_knn15: KNN k=15 on fit-scaled log1p genes
controls.matched_knn15: KNN k=15 on the candidate's exact fit-scaled gene+position representation (strong copying/averaging control)
controls.copy_1nn_location: label copied from the single nearest training-animal cell in fit-scaled position
controls.copy_1nn_matched: label copied from the single nearest training-animal cell in the candidate's exact representation
controls.technical: logistic on authentic technical variables, only when present
controls.donor_rule: every KNN/copy donor comes from training animals only; this is asserted per fold
controls.knn_weighting: KNN and copy controls are unweighted

folds.preferred: leave_one_group_out (each animal or verified pool held out once)
folds.alternative: grouped_kfold with declared k (groups shuffled with seed 20261112)
folds.rule: identical eligible IDs and folds for every method; any missing/invalid probability or one-class/too-small training set is a FAIL, never a dropped row or fallback

metrics.primary: animal-equal Brier and clipped log loss (clip 1e-6), per endpoint, plus every animal's values
metrics.calibration: reported separately: 10-bin reliability table, ECE, per-animal mean p vs observed
metrics.paired_descriptive: for every location/copying control: per-animal (control - candidate) Brier and log loss, mean, min, max and number of animals improved
metrics.macro: target-equal mean of the animal-equal Brier and log loss over the declared targets; per-animal macro = mean over the targets for which that animal has eligible cells, with that coverage reported (complete_coverage flag); paired control-minus-candidate differences reported per target, target-equal, and per-animal macro for every location/copying control

gate.synthetic: software-only checks; says nothing about biology

outputs_per_run.STARTED.json: written exclusively before any data file is parsed or any model fitted; kept on partial failure, so the run_id cannot be silently rerun
outputs_per_run.predictions.csv: keyed out-of-fold predictions: cell_id, group_id, endpoint, fold, method, probability (repr float), captured; one row per eligible cell x endpoint x method
outputs_per_run.RUN_COMPLETE.json: immutable provenance: manifest, analysis config, admission record, source (from admission record), data files, runner, reference, protocol, STARTED, result and predictions hashes

frozen_scope: Exploratory only: exactly one real run, run_id barseq2_a1_598_logo_v1, of the dataset below. Code, protocol and the admission-bound configuration are fixed before the run; no tuning, model selection, recalibration or rerun on its results.

dataset.source: BARseq2 (Sun et al., Nature Neuroscience 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41593-021-00842-4; Mendeley jnx89bmv4s/2) A1 pooled data, A1pooleddata.mat, SHA-256 d4b1ac270b90c15ccb21a5ce06e9baf02eb38eebd52388c1067147be8d8ffa31
dataset.group_unit: animal (two mice; all slices and cells of a mouse stay together; no pools)
dataset.cohort_qc: 598 cells: max raw projection count across the 12 collected target columns > 2 AND max(Slc17a7, Gad1) >= 5 (the published paired QC cohort). The cohort is conditional on an observed capture somewhere; it is not an all-neuron census and includes five inhibitory cells.

position.formula: top_distance / (top_distance + bottom_distance) * 1200 um, from image-based soma centroid distances to the measured cortical top and bottom contours
position.limit: one measured laminar axis; not absolute XYZ; no tangential anatomy control

dataset.target_rule: 11 shared anatomical targets assayed in both mice; the olfactory bulb control column is excluded
dataset.label: captured = raw target molecule count > 2; <= 2 is nondetection in an assayed target, not biological absence

technical_columns.log_panel_total: log1p(sum of the 23 measured marker counts): a capture-size proxy that also contains biology
technical_columns.log_unused_spots: log1p(sum of the two unused-code counts): an assay-background proxy

dataset.folds: leave_one_group_out: 2 folds (train XC95 -> test XC97, and train XC97 -> test XC95)
dataset.calibration_animal: none (no separate calibration animal; calibration is reported descriptively only)
